title: Find Your Perfect Size
description: Enter your body measurements to get a personalized size recommendation for this product.

guide.title: How to Take Your Measurements
guide.height: Height: Stand straight against a wall without shoes
guide.chest: Chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest
guide.waist: Waist: Measure around your natural waistline
guide.hips: Hips: Measure around the fullest part of your hips
guide.inseam: Inseam: Measure from crotch to ankle along the inside of your leg

fit.perfect: Perfect Fit - This size matches your measurements excellently
fit.great: Great Fit - This size should fit you very well
fit.good: Good Fit - This size should work for you
fit.approximate: Approximate Fit - Consider trying this size
